gloss: every nook and cranny; every corner

definitions.gloss: every nook and cranny; every corner; all corners
definitions.explanation: Every part of a space, area, or organization, including the most remote or overlooked parts. Emphasizes thoroughness and completeness.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{隅々|すみずみ}まで{掃除|そうじ}した。
examples.english: I cleaned every corner of the room.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}の{隅々|すみずみ}まで{知|し}り{尽|つ}くしている。
examples.english: I know every nook and cranny of this town.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{建物|たてもの}の{隅々|すみずみ}まで{捜索|そうさく}したが、{証拠|しょうこ}は{見|み}つからなかった。
examples.english: The police searched every corner of the building, but no evidence was found.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle まで to mean "all the way to every corner." The reduplicated form emphasizes thoroughness. Can refer to physical spaces, geographic areas, or abstract domains like organizations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隅々|すみずみ}まで{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean every corner)
- {隅々|すみずみ}まで{行|い}き{届|とど}く (to reach every corner)
- {隅々|すみずみ}まで{目|め}を{配|くば}る (to keep an eye on every detail)
- {国|くに}の{隅々|すみずみ} (every corner of the country)
